description: This file contains utility functions for managing UCI configurations and UBUS interactions in a daemon, including functions to reload services, apply configuration changes, and handle UCI configuration buffers for a network management daemon.

methods.name: void strncpyt(char * dst,const char * src,size_t n)
methods.description: Copies a string into a destination buffer with null-termination, ensuring no buffer overflow.

methods.name: int bbf_config_call(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * object,const char * method,struct blob_buf * data,ubus_data_handler_t callback,void * arg)
methods.description: Performs an UBUS invoke call with object and method, handling lookup and error logging.

methods.name: void reload_service(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * config_name,bool is_commit)
methods.description: Reloads a specific configuration service, either by commit or revert, via UBUS.

methods.name: void reload_specified_services(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,struct blob_attr * services,bool is_commit,bool reload)
methods.description: Reapplies configuration to specified services, optionally committing or reverting, and reloads services if needed.

methods.name: void reload_all_services(struct ubus_context * ctx,const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,bool is_commit,bool reload)
methods.description: Iterates over all UCI configs and reloads services similarly.

methods.name: void uci_apply_changes(const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,bool is_commit)
methods.description: Applies or reverts all UCI configuration changes across all configs.

methods.name: void uci_config_changes(const char * conf_dir,const char * save_dir,struct blob_buf * bb)
methods.description: Identifies configs with unsaved changes and adds them to a blob buffer for further processing.
